outline: 本課程之教學目標在使學生瞭解通訊系統的理論基礎及原理。本課程著重於類比系統。課程內容包含：(1) Fourier series and Fourier transform, (2) Signals and linear systems, (3) Linear modulation techniques, (4) Stochastic process and power spectral density, (6) Modeling of noise and its effects on communication systems
schedule:
Week	Topic	Memo
1	Overview and history
2	Fundamental of signals and Fourier series
3	Fourier series and Fourier transform
4	Power spectral density and correlation	Test1
5	Signals and linear systems
6	Sampling theory
7	Modulation techniques: linear modulation
8	AM, FM, PLL, PPM, PWM, PCM, and delta modulation
9	Test2 (MIDTERM)
10	Multiplexing
11	Review of probability theory
12	Stochastic process
13	Correlation and power spectral density
14	Linear systems and random process 	Test3
15	Narrowband noise
16	Noise effect in modulation system: SNR and signal degradation
17	Noise effect of AM, FM, and PCM systems
18	Test4 (FINAL)
assessment:
測驗一(25%)、測驗二(25%; 期中考週)、測驗三(25%)、測驗四(25%; 期末考週)
(Bonus: 全勤+5%; 期末報告/程式 +5%)
(註: 測驗可包含考試與程式)
